title: AgentReturnContract
description: The dict that run_agent() must return. 'action' is the only required key. The adapter reads all other keys conditionally based on the action value.

action.description: What the adapter should do after run_agent returns. 'none' is a no-op (still logs reasoning).

to.description: Recipient email address. Required when action is 'send_email'.

subject.description: Email subject line. Required when action is 'send_email'.

text.description: Email body (plain text). Required when action is 'send_email' or 'reply_email'.

thread_id.description: AgentMail thread ID. Required when action is 'reply_email'. Pass null to start a fresh thread.

message_id.description: AgentMail message ID of the message being replied to. Required when action is 'reply_email'.

task_type.description: Human-readable label for the type of task handled (e.g. 'schedule_meeting', 'data_pull'). Used in approval queue UI and logging.

reasoning.description: Agent's internal reasoning for the chosen action. Logged for audit, shown in approval queue. Never sent to external recipients.

approval_id.description: The approval_id returned by queue_approval(). Required when action is 'resolve_approval'. Must match a pending approval in the queue.

resolution.description: How the human resolved the approval. Required when action is 'resolve_approval'.

edited_text.description: The human's edited email body when resolution is 'EDITED'. Null if not edited.

rejection_reason.description: Free-text reason for rejection when resolution is 'REJECTED'. Null if not rejected.

needs_approval.description: If true, the adapter will queue this action for human review regardless of the approval policy. Use when the agent itself determines the action is too risky to auto-execute.

risk_assessment.description: Agent's self-assessed risk scores for the action. Each field is 1–10. 'combined' is the overall risk score; the adapter auto-queues if combined >= 6.0 and approval policy is 'risk-based'.

stakes.description: How severe the consequences of a mistake would be (1 = trivial, 10 = catastrophic).

ambiguity.description: How unclear or underspecified the request is (1 = crystal clear, 10 = highly ambiguous).

reversibility.description: How hard it is to undo the action (1 = easily reversible, 10 = irreversible).

combined.description: Overall risk score. Adapter uses: (stakes * 0.4 + ambiguity * 0.3 + reversibility * 0.3) if this field is absent.

insight_worthy.description: Set to true to signal the adapter to forward 'insight' to AgentMind. Only set when you have learned something genuinely reusable.

insight.description: Knowledge to contribute to AgentMind. Only used when insight_worthy is true.

title.description: Concise, imperative title (e.g. 'Always lead escalation emails with the resolution').

content.description: Actionable insight content. Dense, not verbose. No PII or company names.

google_read_requests.description: Requests for additional Google Workspace data. The platform fetches these and calls run_agent again with the results injected into context before sending any reply.

type.description: Which Google read operation to perform.

file_id.description: Google Drive file ID for drive_get_file, sheets_read, docs_read.

time_min.description: ISO 8601 datetime for calendar_list start bound.

time_max.description: ISO 8601 datetime for calendar_list end bound.

google_writes.description: Google Workspace write operations. Executed after the email/reply is sent (or after action='none'). All writes execute even if a previous write fails.

values.description: 2D array of values for sheets_write and sheets_append.

event_id.description: Google Calendar event ID for calendar_update and calendar_delete.

attendees.description: List of attendee email addresses for calendar_create.
